caption:
Can AI infrastructure handle the demand? 86% of enterprises run GPUs at half capacity or less.

Enterprises are running AI agents ahead of the controls needed to manage them, and they deployed that way knowingly. A survey of 573 technical leaders at companies with 100 or more employees found that 86% of enterprises that run their own GPUs report utilization of 50% or less.

The measurement gap compounds the issue: only 44% of enterprises rigorously track what their AI compute actually costs and returns. Everyone else is only estimating.

Enterprises are already paying the price for deploying agents ahead of adequate control functions. Fifty-four percent of companies had an agent security incident or near-miss caught before harm in the past 12 months.

Roughly six in 10 enterprises plan to switch or add vendors in each of five control layers within the next 12 months, and roughly a third plan to move within the quarter.
